description: This file contains CMake functions, macros, and configurations for managing build dependencies, target properties, installation procedures, and generating package configuration files in a CMake-based project. It includes utility functions for handling libraries, include directories, compile definitions, and installation of configuration files.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Derives a default link name and location from a library file path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the list of libraries and directories that a target links against, including dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Extracts compile definitions from a target, including propagated definitions from dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Collects compile options from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Gathers include directories from a target and its dependencies, resolving paths and filtering.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs CMake package configuration files (.cmake) for a target, with dependency handling.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, including compile options, defines, and include directories.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs custom CMake find modules from a specified directory.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Outputs the list of supported CMake target properties.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Prints all properties of a specified target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Escapes semicolons in a string for safe usage in CMake commands.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a compatible, legacy CMake interface for a target, including headers and linking.
